en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large wooden water slide or chute at a seaside amusement area. A woman in a swimsuit sits on a sled at the top of the slide, about to descend. Safety nets are strung along both sides of the slide. Below are crowds of bathers and structures that look like changing cabins or beach facilities. The scene appears sunny with a few clouds and trees in the background. Printed captions in Bulgarian (Cyrillic) and German appear at the bottom of the image.
